text:
Maria R: Heads-up — we just had a host OOM in prod during a long multi-turn session (client X, ~40k token sliding window). stack traces point at KV allocator growth, but patterns look like some prefixes aren't being reclaimed.
Jon P: Ugh. Which pool/slot? any repro token sequence?
Maria R: Sticky slot growth on shard g4-06, slot ids mostly in the 0x7f.. range. Not a single huge allocation but a slow accumulation.
Taylor: Could be reuse counts not decaying because of a bug in the last-touch update. I saw similar in a bench where repeated prefix lookups bypassed the LRU bump.
Cheng: I captured a heap-sample. small snippet: ```
# heap-sample
KVSlotCount: 124k
ActivePrefixes: 28k
AvgSlotSize: 512
EvictCandidates: 3.4k
PinnedByRequest: 1.2k
```
Maria R: Thanks. We need a mitigation ASAP: propose a temporary "safe-bailout" flow — when per-host KV growth rate > 15% in 1m, start shedding low-heat prefixes and route new requests to a quantized variant (or lower-context) with a 503->retry header to clients.
Jon P: We should also add a fast sampling tracer to avoid full heap prof all the time. Sample 1/100 requests and log prefix reuse histogram. That will help reproduce without noise.
Taylor: Agreed. Operationally: 1) implement sample tracer 2) add eviction score tweak to prioritize long-stale sticky prefixes 3) add per-request reservation cap so one request can't hold >N slots.
Cheng: For the eviction score I suggest combining heat and age like: `score = heat / (1 + age_secs/60) + frag_penalty` so very old low-heat prefixes drop fast.
Jon P: Also we need fallback policy in routing layer: when host signals "kv-high-water" then route to secondary pool with KV-compact enabled. That buys time while we GC.
Maria R: I'll open a short-term runbook: immediate mitigations + telemetry. Draft: 1) enable safe-bailout threshold (15% growth/1m), 2) enable aggressive eviction of score<0.2, 3) route new long-context requests to dedicated longctx pool with higher autoscale, 4) trigger oncall if eviction rate > 10k/min.
Taylor: Small patch ready for sampling tracer — log format below. Will PR after tests. ```json
{"sample_id":"${SAMPLE}","prefix_len":256,"reuse_count":12,"slot_id":"0x7fabc","host":"g4-06"}
```
rufus-bot: Canary deploy queued for staging at 15:12 UTC — will report success/fail. :gear:
ops-bot: Alert rule suggestion: `kv_host_growth_rate > 0.15 for 60s => severity=P2, runbook=kv-sticky-bailout`
Maria R: Good. Longer term we should investigate root cause: regression in touch/update path after the kernel-selection perf change last week. Could be that new code paths bypass the reuse counter update in hot path.
Cheng: I'll add unit tests for touch/update and a stress bench with pathological repeated prefix access. Also will run the memsan reproducer from nightlies.
Jon P: Post-mortem note: this thread + heap samples + tracer logs should be enough to avoid noisy full heap dumps. We should also consider an adaptive compact scheduler that runs compaction when fragmentation metric > 30%.
Maria R: Thanks all — I'll prod the oncall if canary fails. Follow-ups: PRs from Taylor (sampling) and Cheng (score tweak + tests). Will update here once canary is green. :thumbsup:
